|game_text=Deploy on [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies{{!}}Infiltration]] with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe{{!}}Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is version PC-E3 of [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)|Scoundrel's Luck]]. The first printing is lost, so it has no page. Other versions: [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5, the current text). No image of the card list is published; the image shown is [[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelsluck-pre.gif]], the document of PC-E5 (the Players Committee card image), which prints the same words. (A CardMaker recreation was tried on 11 November 2026, but the long text pushes the banner into the art window, so it was not used.)
* '''Original''' (first printing; no copy survives, so no page): the first Virtual Block 8.1 printing (official text as of 11 May 2012). No copy of it has been found: the surviving sheet was re-made on 18 July 2012 with the PC-E1 errata. The PC website card list (PC-E3) and the Players Committee card image (PC-E5) print a wording without “(even if inactive)”, which is probably the first text, but the sheet's own words are not known.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 13 July 2012, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p739757">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 13 July 2012: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=60#p739757 p739757] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive). Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “(even if inactive)” added after “stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here”, so that the Effects come back even if a scoundrel is captured or missing.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 2)]]): re-made Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (still headed “official text as of 11 May 2012”; PDF dated 18 July 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 7, slip 38 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive). Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E1 forum text. The forum post and the sheet are two publications, so two versions (Bill, 11 November 2026). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012)<ref name="cl-1281_37-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “(even if inactive)” is gone. A repeat of an earlier text after a different one was published is a version of its own (wiki versions ruling, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Light Side, p. 29)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=29, page 29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=29 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive). Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “(even if inactive)” is back: word for word the PC-E1 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E5''' ([[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 5)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 7 May 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 7 May 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “(even if inactive)” is gone again: word for word the PC-E3 text. Because the image is dated after the Master List, it is the latest version and the current text (Bill, 11 November 2026). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
